purpose: Small, strict command contract for designing, auditing, fixing and compiling websites without repository crawling or prompt aliases.

authority.creative: The user's design conversation owns art direction. /ideate must not impose a house style.
authority.conversion: The seam.kiwe application is the only authority that emits production Bricks JSON. Browser AI only prepares source and binding intent.
authority.siteContext: SiteGraph is an attached or connected input and carries embedded Design Context; neither is a slash command.
authority.framework: Seam Framework is an explicit seam.kiwe compilation option, never an automatic rewrite.

requires: project request and any supplied files; SiteGraph only when preflight proves it is required
outputs: Design Context coverage report before modification
commands.boundary: Classify the project, SiteGraph requirement and Design Context coverage before adapting a new build, redesign or source enhancement. Preserve accepted art direction and do not emit Bricks JSON.

requires: SiteGraph when real site fields are requested
commands.boundary: Prepare Bricks dynamic intent for seam.kiwe. Never emit Bricks JSON.
Read only. Never modify the submitted artifact.
Audit only. Use /fix to create a changed artifact.
Apply only proven findings and preserve art direction, content and behavior.
Discard the failed output as authority; return to the last accepted artifact.

cachePolicy: Fetch the versioned manifest advertised by entry.json. Do not reuse a different contract version from conversation memory.
